header.userPrompt: Add a sample of Scala3 type lambdas

resultJson.title: Add Scala 3 type lambdas sample
resultJson.body:
Adds `blog/TypeLambdas.scala`, a sample of Scala 3 type lambdas (`[A] =>> ...`). It defines a `Functor` typeclass with instances for `List`, `Either[String, _]` (via a type alias), and `Map[String, _]` (via an inline type lambda). It also shows a fixed-first-parameter tuple (`Pair`) and a nested type (`OptList`). A `@main` demo prints the results.

The diff also includes generated files: `.bsp/sbt.json`, `.orca/settings.properties` and an orca progress log. The `.bsp/sbt.json` file contains a machine-specific Nix store path.
